[[Cherami Leigh]] ([[JN138]])| java1=[[Megumi Hayashibara]]| }} '''Misty's Azurill''' (Japanese: '''カスミのルリリ''' ''Kasumi's Ruriri'') was a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} acquired by {{an|Misty}} in the [[Kanto]] [[region]], and her eleventh overall. ==History== ==={{aniseries|RS}}=== [[File:Misty and Azurill.png|thumb|left|220px|Azurill and Misty]] Azurill is the child of [[Tracey's Marill]], though it is unknown which Pokémon was the other parent. Misty mentioned that {{Tracey}} gave it to her when it was just an {{pkmn|Egg}}. Azurill debuted in ''[[AG132|The Scheme Team]]'', when {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} arrived in [[Pallet Town]] to embark on Ash's {{pkmn|journey}} to challenge the {{gdis|Battle Frontier|III}}. In ''[[AG133|The Right Place and the Right Mime]]'', Azurill paired up with Tracey's Marill to fight off {{TRT}}'s attack on [[Professor Oak's Laboratory]]. Later, Azurill accompanied Misty while she was on her way back to the [[Cerulean Gym]], with the group accompanying them on their way to the {{gdis|Battle Factory|III}}. In ''[[AG134|A Real Cleffa-Hanger]]'', Team Rocket attacked the group as they picnicked at the foot of [[Mt. Moon]]. Azurill, notably, befriended a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Cleffa}} who had become separated from its family. The group eventually foiled another Team Rocket scheme and helped the Cleffa reunite with its family. Afterwards, Misty and Azurill left Ash and the others and returned to the Cerulean Gym. ==={{aniseries|JN}}=== Azurill reappeared in ''[[JN138|A Fated Face-Off!]]''. During the episode, it reunited with Ash and watched as he and its Trainer battled over a wild {{p|Clauncher}}. After Misty won the battle and caught {{TP|Misty|Clauncher}}, it celebrated with her and {{TP|Misty|Psyduck}}. ==Personality and characteristics== [[File:Misty Azurill and Cleffa.png|thumb|left|220px|Azurill playing with a wild Cleffa]] [[File:Marill Azurill.png|thumb|220px|Azurill ready to battle alongside its parent, {{TP|Tracey|Marill}}]] Despite being small, Azurill is already powerful, assisting in the effort to fend off {{TRT}} in ''[[AG133|The Right Place and the Right Mime]]''. Much like {{TP|Misty|Togepi}} before it, Azurill is usually held in Misty's arms. As a [[baby Pokémon]], Azurill is very playful, as seen when it was playing with a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Cleffa}}, using its ball-like tail to entertain the {{pkmn|category|Star Shape Pokémon}}. It is also very sociable, helpful, and friendly towards other Pokémon, as seen when it healed {{AP|Pikachu}} from his injuries by using Refresh. {{-}} ==Moves used== {{anmov/h|normal||Misty Azurill {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Water Gun|1=Refresh|2=Bubble}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Water Gun|1=Refresh|2=Bubble}}}} {{anmov|water|Water Gun|AG133|The Right Place and the Right Mime}} {{anmov|normal|Refresh|AG134|A Real Cleffa-Hanger}} {{anmov|water|Bubble|AG134|A Real Cleffa-Hanger}} {{anmov/f|normal}} ==Trivia== * Azurill is the only one of {{an|Misty}}'s {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}: ** That she currently owns to not be a {{t|Water}} type. ** To not be weak to {{type|Electric}} [[move]]s. * Azurill is the only Pokémon hatched from an {{pkmn|Egg}} in the {{pkmn|animated series}} to have a confirmed relation with a main character's Pokémon. * Azurill is the first Pokémon hatched be a main character to have never been seen as an Egg. * Azurill was seen using more [[move]]s than its [[Tracey's Marill|parent]]. * Azurill has the lowest [[List of Pokémon by base stats|base stat total]] of any Pokémon owned by a main character. ==Related articles== {{Animespecies|Azurill}} * [[Tracey's Marill]] {{Misty's Pokémon|normal}} {{Tracey's Pokémon|???}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Azurill}} [[Category:Misty's Pokémon]] [[Category:Animated series Pokémon hatched from Eggs]] [[de:Mistys Azurill]] [[es:Azurill de Misty]] [[fr:Azurill d'Ondine]] [[it:Azurill di Misty]] [[ja:カスミのルリリ]] [[zh:小霞的露力丽]]
